source: DualChem official PDF, retrieved 2026-10-31; sections 5.1, 6.1 and Table 4 footnote

human_question_paired.limitation: Question-only inference; participant assignment not randomized. Repeated participant dependence and selection cannot be addressed from these aggregates. Not a causal human-uplift estimate.

web_search_denominator.interpretation: Arithmetic from rounded published percent. Failure counted as not successfully answered. No raw correct count inferred; no CI or paired test for the tool contrast. Changes estimand, not correction of a hidden arithmetic error.
